checks.name: A1: every joined spatial feature carries its layer vintage
A2: a historical cutoff resolves identically whether computed with only the vintages published by then, or with the full present-day series
A3: the pre-subdivision and post-subdivision footprints are both reachable, and the retired BBL is preserved
A4: implementation events join to the authorizing determination and drive a remedy-exposure projection

gap.statement: No pluto layer vintage covers 2018-06-01 for BBL 3099990010. This is reported as a coverage gap; the join is refused rather than completed with the current or nearest available vintage.

checks.name: A5: an unknown-vintage layer join is refused and reported as a coverage gap, never completed with current data
negative rule: PLUTO's current (post-2021) vintage is never substituted for a pre-2019 cutoff
existing warehouse test suites for the modules this card introduces stay green
